title: parashorea lucida
intro: Parashorea lucida, commonly known as the glossy white lauan or white lauan, is a species of tree in the family Dipterocarpaceae. This tree is native to Southeast Asia and is valued for its timber and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Parashorea lucida include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce inflammation, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its health benefits.
